policy: Canonical labels are for current narrative and navigation. Legacy identifiers, source paths, contracts, execution IDs, cohort IDs, and results remain unchanged for provenance.

research.title: Structural accuracy and decision performance can diverge
research.question: Why is structural accuracy alone insufficient to characterize decision value?

substudies.title: TEP causal discovery and structural accuracy assessment
Structural accuracy and decision performance in synthetic settings

limitations: Synthetic results do not establish physical manufacturing effects.

research.title: Why task-oriented repair location matters (WHERE)
research.question: Where should limited repair effort be allocated?
research.evidence_status: Synthesis of distinct cohorts and post-hoc supplements
limitations: Repair is reference-assisted; atomic edit count is not monetary cost.

research.title: Repair priority and value of additional structure (WHAT & WHY)
research.question: Within task-relevant errors, what should be repaired first, why, and does finer structural information add dependable value?
research.evidence_status: Exploratory, retrospective, development and replication evidence; policy superiority not established

substudies.title: Structural metrics and within-task repair policies
Development and independent evaluation of detailed repair policies
Incremental value of error-type and structural information

limitations: S6 is retrospective on reused data; high tie mass; no superiority, equivalence, or noninferiority established.

research.title: Generalization to external causal environments (GENERALIZATION)
research.question: Which findings carry over to external causal environments represented by semisynthetic benchmarks?
research.evidence_status: Conditional semisynthetic evidence and incomplete computational feasibility work
limitations: Research D/S5 are conditional semisynthetic settings, not physical manufacturing validation.
S7 persisted 0/400 G0 and 0/24000 recommendations; evaluator not run; no external performance result.

research.title: Repair budget and resource allocation (HOW MUCH)
research.question: How far should repair proceed given marginal benefit and actual edit count?

substudies.title: Marginal benefit and cost-weighted policy analysis

limitations: Lambda is a hypothetical edit-count penalty, not money or labor cost.
C/S4 regret and S5 tracking loss are not combined.

cross_study_evidence.rule: Cohorts and estimands remain separate; shared path does not imply pooled population.
